name: Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy
definition: Length-dependent peripheral neuropathy associated with diabetes, typically producing distal sensory loss, neuropathic pain and reduced protective sensation.

redFlags.item: New cord or cauda equina signs

investigations.principle: Typical DPN is mainly a clinical diagnosis; evaluate for other treatable causes when atypical.
investigations.radiographs: Electrodiagnostic testing is selected for atypical/asymmetric/motor presentations.

green: Optimize glycemic and cardiovascular risk factors
Daily foot care and protective footwear
amber: Neuropathic-pain medicines require individualized renal/hepatic, interaction and fall-risk review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Madhumeha-associated Vata/Dhatu/Srotas dysfunction may be assessed in parallel; modern diabetic neuropathy care remains essential.

patientEducation.summary: Length-dependent peripheral neuropathy associated with diabetes, typically producing distal sensory loss, neuropathic pain and reduced protective sensation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
